code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#E8D8B8'; const hw=100; const hh=80; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; for(let i=0;i<4;i++) svg += `<rect x="${i*hw/3-2}" y="${-10}" width="4" height="20" fill="#8B7355" stroke="#6B5335" stroke-width="${ol*0.3}"/>`; svg += `<rect x="-5" y="${-hh}" width="${hw+10}" height="${hh-10}" rx="2" fill="${col}" stroke="#B8986A" stroke-width="${ol}"/>`; svg += `<rect x="-10" y="${-hh+25}" width="${hw+20}" height="4" fill="#C8A878" stroke="#B8986A" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ const rx=-5+i*((hw+10)/8); svg += `<line x1="${rx}" y1="${-hh+29}" x2="${rx}" y2="${-hh+42}" stroke="#C8A878" stroke-width="1.5"/>`; } svg += `<line x1="-8" y1="${-hh+42}" x2="${hw+8}" y2="${-hh+42}" stroke="#C8A878" stroke-width="2"/>`; svg += `<polygon points="-15,${-hh} ${hw/2},${-hh-30} ${hw+15},${-hh}" fill="#8B4513" stroke="#6B3010" stroke-width="${ol}"/>`; for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ const wxp=10+i*hw*0.32; const wyp=-hh+35; svg += `<rect x="${wxp}" y="${wyp}" width="18" height="20" rx="1" fill="rgba(135,206,235,0.3)" stroke="#B8986A" stroke-width="${ol*0.5}"/>`; svg += `<line x1="${wxp+9}" y1="${wyp}" x2="${wxp+9}" y2="${wyp+20}" stroke="#B8986A" stroke-width="1"/>`; svg += `<line x1="${wxp}" y1="${wyp+10}" x2="${wxp+18}" y2="${wyp+10}" stroke="#B8986A" stroke-width="1"/>`; } svg += `<rect x="${hw*0.42}" y="${-hh+42}" width="14" height="25" rx="1" fill="#C45A3A" stroke="#8B3A1A" stroke-width="${ol*0.5}"/>`; svg += `</g>`; return svg;
